responsibility: Windows window launcher installed as desktop\orchbee-desktop.exe in the release store: reads the window pointer beside it and starts the active window version of the same name with its own arguments and environment, waits for the window that asked for a relaunch to end, and starts the previous window version once when the active one cannot start or ends with a failure soon after.
nonGoals: Installing, verifying, activating or cleaning up a window version, moving the window pointer, or recording a failure.
Reading configuration, settings or any file besides the window pointer, or choosing a version other than the active one or the pointer's previous one.
Owning the window's lifetime, starting a Job, or running on macOS or Linux.
